Selected project / 07

AmitBookDepot

Visit platform↗

The context.

Book retail has operational needs that a basic online catalog does not cover. The platform combines an online bookstore with a custom ERP for stock, billing, people, and customer operations, including business rules specific to books and institutional retail.

My contribution.

  1. Build e-commerce capabilities for books, stationery, academic products, and related retail categories.
  2. Develop attendance, payroll, overtime calculation, and operational reporting modules.
  3. Implement inventory management, invoice generation, POS billing, customer/student records, and categorization.
  4. Model bookstore-specific stock, billing, and rental business rules.
  5. Connect email, SMS, and WhatsApp communication workflows for customer engagement and operations.

The result.

  • Connected storefront and back-office workflows in a purpose-built operational platform.
  • Reduced fragmentation across inventory, billing, staff, and customer information.
The most useful business software reflects the details of how that business actually works.
